Nar Nari 2.0

01st October 2026 - 06th October 2026

Nar Nari 2.0 is a new and evolved body of work exploring the eternal balance between masculine and feminine energies. The collection reflects equality, coexistence, emotional strength, and the idea that two contrasting forces together create wholeness. Rather than conflict, the works celebrate harmony between opposites—logic and intuition, structure and softness, earth and spirit. Mahesh Sharma is an Indian multidisciplinary artist and designer known for his powerful fusion of fine art, sculpture, and collectible design. With over twenty-five years of creative experience, his work spans exhibitions, installations, furniture-art, and large-scale conceptual presentations in India and abroad. His artistic language is rooted in nature, human psychology, equality, spirituality, and material transformation. Through painting, sculpture, and mixed media, Mahesh Sharma creates works that are both visually striking and philosophically layered. He is widely recognized for developing original collections that merge art and function while maintaining a strong emotional and symbolic presence.
